properties.title: Pacific Ocean
properties.desc: Borders the Americas, Asia and Oceania. Carries the main trans-Pacific trade lanes. Area 161,760,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q98 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Atlantic Ocean
properties.desc: Between the Americas, Europe and Africa. Main transatlantic trade and security corridor. Area 106,460,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q97 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Indian Ocean
properties.desc: Africa, Asia and Australia. Carries Gulf energy exports to Asia and the Suez-Asia trade.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q1239; point checked against P625

properties.title: Arctic Ocean
properties.desc: Ringed by Russia, Canada, the US, Norway and Denmark (Greenland). Opening sea routes and contested resource claims. Area 14,056,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q788 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Southern Ocean
properties.desc: Surrounds Antarctica. Governed under the Antarctic Treaty system; fisheries interest. Area 20,327,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q7354 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Persian / Arabian Gulf
properties.desc: Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, UAE (Oman at Musandam). Core of Gulf oil and gas exports; the UAE's home waters. Area 251,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q34675 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Gulf of Oman
properties.desc: Iran, Oman, UAE and Pakistan. Open-sea side of Hormuz and home of Fujairah, the UAE's Indian Ocean outlet.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q79948; point checked against P625

properties.title: Arabian Sea
properties.desc: India, Pakistan, Iran, Oman, Yemen and Somalia. Main route for Gulf energy to South and East Asia; naval patrol area. Area 3,862,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q58705 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Red Sea
properties.desc: Egypt, Sudan, Eritrea, Saudi Arabia and Yemen. Links Suez to the Indian Ocean; Houthi attacks since 2023 diverted shipping.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q23406; point checked against P625

properties.title: Gulf of Aden
properties.desc: Yemen, Somalia and Djibouti. Approach to Bab el-Mandeb; piracy and naval escort zone.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q41837; point checked against P625

properties.title: Gulf of Aqaba
properties.desc: Egypt, Israel, Jordan and Saudi Arabia. Sea outlet for Eilat and Aqaba, reached through the Straits of Tiran.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q81611; point checked against P625

properties.title: Gulf of Suez
properties.desc: Egypt. Southern approach to the Suez Canal, with offshore oil fields.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q168277; point checked against P625

properties.title: Mediterranean Sea
properties.desc: Southern Europe, North Africa and the Levant. Crossroads of Europe-Asia trade, energy and migration routes. Area 2,500,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q4918 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Black Sea
properties.desc: Turkey, Bulgaria, Romania, Ukraine, Russia and Georgia. Grain and energy exports; the Russia-Ukraine war has disrupted shipping since 2022. Area 436,402 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q166 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Caspian Sea
properties.desc: Russia, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Iran and Azerbaijan. Landlocked; legal status set by the 2018 Convention; oil, gas and pipelines. Area 386,400 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q5484 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Sea of Azov
properties.desc: Russia and Ukraine. Shallow sea reached only through the Kerch Strait; Russian-occupied coast since 2022. Area 37,600 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q35000 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Aegean Sea
properties.desc: Greece and Turkey. Site of maritime and airspace boundary disputes between them. Area 214,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q34575 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Adriatic Sea
properties.desc: Italy, Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia, Montenegro and Albania. Links Balkan ports to Italy and the EU.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q13924; point checked against P625

properties.title: Baltic Sea
properties.desc: Sweden, Finland, Russia, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Germany and Denmark. All coastal states except Russia are NATO members; undersea cable and pipeline security. Area 377,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q545 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: North Sea
properties.desc: UK, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium and France. Offshore oil, gas and wind; busy shipping lanes. Area 570,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q1693 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Barents Sea
properties.desc: Norway and Russia. Home waters of Russia's Northern Fleet and Arctic energy; 2010 Norway-Russia boundary treaty. Area 1,424,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q45823 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Norwegian Sea
properties.desc: Norway, Iceland and Greenland. Route for Russian naval access to the Atlantic. Area 1,383,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q47545 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Caribbean Sea
properties.desc: Central America, northern South America and island states. US security sphere; migration and trafficking routes. Area 2,754,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q1247 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Gulf of Mexico
properties.desc: US, Mexico and Cuba. Major oil and gas production and Gulf Coast ports. Area 1,550,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q12630 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: South China Sea
properties.desc: China, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, Brunei, Taiwan and Indonesia. Contested island and maritime claims on a major global trade route. Area 3,500,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q37660 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: East China Sea
properties.desc: China, Japan, South Korea and Taiwan. Disputed Senkaku/Diaoyu islands and overlapping zones.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q45341; point checked against P625

properties.title: Yellow Sea
properties.desc: China, North Korea and South Korea. Overlapping maritime zones and fishing disputes. Area 380,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q37960 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Sea of Japan (East Sea)
properties.desc: Japan, Russia, North Korea and South Korea. Missile tests and Korean Peninsula tension.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q27092; point checked against P625

properties.title: Philippine Sea
properties.desc: Philippines, Japan, Taiwan and Pacific islands. Deployment area for US and allied navies. Area 5,000,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q159183 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Bay of Bengal
properties.desc: India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Myanmar. Arena of Indian Ocean naval competition and trade to Southeast Asia. Area 2,172,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q38684 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Andaman Sea
properties.desc: Myanmar, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia and India. Western approach to the Strait of Malacca. Area 798,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q47632 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Sea of Okhotsk
properties.desc: Russia and Japan. Largely a Russian sea; Kuril Islands dispute. Area 1,583,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q41602 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Bering Sea
properties.desc: Russia and the United States. Gateway to the Arctic; fisheries and northern sea routes. Area 2,300,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q44725 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Gulf of Guinea
properties.desc: West and Central African coastal states. Oil production and a piracy hotspot.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q41430; point checked against P625

properties.title: Sea of Marmara
properties.desc: Turkey. Lies wholly within Turkey and links the Bosphorus to the Dardanelles. Area 11,350 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q35367 (P2046 area); point checked against P625

properties.title: Gulf of Thailand
properties.desc: Thailand, Cambodia, Vietnam and Malaysia. Overlapping Thai-Cambodian claims and offshore gas. Area 320,000 km2.
properties.src: Wikipedia; Wikidata Q131217 (P2046 area); point checked against P625
